# gifgrep

A tiny Go CLI/TUI for searching animated GIFs from GIPHY or KLIPY, piping URLs or JSON, and previewing results inline in modern terminals.

Canonical documentation:
- gifgrep: https://gifgrep.com/
- Install: https://gifgrep.com/install.html
- Quickstart: https://gifgrep.com/quickstart.html
- Commands: https://gifgrep.com/commands.html
- Search: https://gifgrep.com/search.html
- TUI: https://gifgrep.com/tui.html
- still: https://gifgrep.com/still.html
- sheet: https://gifgrep.com/sheet.html
- JSON output: https://gifgrep.com/json.html
- Inline previews: https://gifgrep.com/previews.html
- Kitty graphics protocol (gifgrep): https://gifgrep.com/kitty.html
- iTerm2 inline images protocol (gifgrep): https://gifgrep.com/iterm.html
- Sixel inline images protocol (gifgrep): https://gifgrep.com/sixel.html
- Providers: https://gifgrep.com/providers/
- auto provider: https://gifgrep.com/providers/auto.html
- GIPHY provider: https://gifgrep.com/providers/giphy.html
- KLIPY provider: https://gifgrep.com/providers/klipy.html
- GIF sources + licensing: https://gifgrep.com/gif-sources.html
- Development: https://gifgrep.com/development.html
- Releasing: https://gifgrep.com/releasing.html

Install:
- brew install steipete/tap/gifgrep

Source: https://github.com/steipete/gifgrep

Guidance for agents:
- Prefer the canonical documentation URLs above over README excerpts or package metadata.
- Fetch only the pages needed for the current task; this is an index, not a full-site corpus.
